name: tests-75pct-mobly-synchronized-multi-sniffer-capture-groups
instr:
Add named sniffer capture groups. Preserve existing behaviour.

Reject empty or duplicate membership with CaptureGroupError before preparation. Prepare in declared order; all members become ready before any commit and before start returns. Preparation/readiness failure raises CaptureGroupStartError with an immutable failed report listing every declared member, aborts prepared members in reverse order and never commits earlier members. Preparation failure skips later members.

Forward duration and packet_count to each preparation. Tcpdump declares packet_count without native_duration; tshark declares both. Reject required unsupported native duration before preparation or launch. Permit duration without a native requirement on limited backends.

Reports retain owner_id and member order through start, stop and wait. Terminal report fields and member collections are immutable. Repeated stop and wait after stop return equal terminal outcomes without repeating termination effects.

RuntimeTestInfo.capture_group uses current signature and output_path and inherits duration, packet_count and require_native_duration defaults. Runtime terminal serialization occurs once on repeated stop, uses TestSummaryEntryType.CAPTURE_GROUP, and includes owner signature, member name and a relative artifact path. cleanup_capture_groups stops owned groups and returns cleanup failures separately.

These are required in what you deliver:

- mobly.capture_group: frozen CaptureMember(name, sniffer); Capture
